title: The Mismeasure of Man and Models: Evaluating Allocational Harms in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring allocational gaps and prediction biases in a simulated resume screening task by comparing LLM selection rates and ranking scores for candidate profiles using names statistically associated with different racial and ethnic groups (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic).

Evaluating allocational gaps and prediction biases in a simulated resume screening task by comparing LLM selection rates and ranking scores for candidate profiles using names statistically associated with different genders (Female, Male).

Assessing allocational disparities in an essay grading task by comparing LLM evaluations and scores of essays written by first language (L1) English speakers versus second language (L2) English learners from various countries.
